A Home I Imagine

A home can begin as an idea and take shape in many forms. In this workshop, imagination leads the design process. Through drawing, building, and assembling materials, children develop their own vision of a home and translate it into a tangible model. Each creation results in a constructed home that reflects personal ideas and vision.

Built by Nature

A bird&rsquo;s nest, a termite mound, a shell, each one is carefully built, not by chance, but by need. In this workshop, children observe how living things design their homes, then borrow these ideas to sketch and shape their own. Openings for air, layers for protection, and smart use of materials begin to appear in their designs. What starts in nature slowly turns into a built form.

My Family Bouquet

A bouquet grows, one flower at a time. In this hands-on workshop, children begin with simple shapes and watch them take form as each piece is rolled, combined, and built into a flower. Colors are chosen, details are added, and the process repeats, each new bloom adding to the whole. As the bouquet comes together, each flower stands for someone at home, gathered into one arrangement shaped through making and choice.

Treasures in Every Home

Deep within the Earth, metal begins its journey, formed over time and transformed into materials we use every day at home. In this interactive workshop, children follow this journey, then reshape a simple tin container into a new functional object. The activity introduces how materials can be reused and redesigned for new purposes..

My Neighbor Totoro

A gentle and magical tale by Studio Ghibli that celebrates the innocence of childhood, the quiet beauty of nature, and the meaning of home found in family. Through the eyes of two sisters who move to the countryside, the story unfolds into a world of forest spirits and unseen friends.

Night at Ithra

An exclusive family experience for Ithra members. Imagine Ithra transformed into a living, breathing home, where footsteps soften and a new experience begins. &ldquo;A Night at Ithra&rdquo; is an immersive evening for families to explore a range of curated spaces across Ithra. The program moves through key locations including the Children&rsquo;s Museum, library, theater, museum, and outdoor areas, with each stop offering a different activity or perspective. The evening concludes with a shared meal and an optional film screening. Designed for families with children aged 7 and above.

Nature's Architects

Nature builds without blueprints, yet every structure serves a clear purpose. The experience begins with a short film that reveals how living organisms design and construct their homes. This is followed by hands-on activities where children explore these ideas further, testing, building, and observing how form responds to need. The workshop connects observation with practical understanding.

Finding Nemo

Everything changes when a father clownfish loses his son in a single moment, setting off on a journey across vast distances and endless dangers. Amid the ocean&rsquo;s shifting waves, the search becomes a test that reveals the strength of family bonds that never break, no matter how far apart they are.

Kinusaiga Art

This workshop invites mothers and children to explore the meaning of home through texture, layering and memory. Using the contemporary fabric Japanese art of Kinusaiga, participants will create a fabric piece by choosing materials that feel familiar and comforting. The experience celebrates how home is felt through touch, emotion and personal expression.

In a world where trees have disappeared, a young boy named Ted goes on a journey to discover a real tree. Along the way, he encounters the Lorax, a guardian who speaks on behalf of the trees. This leads to a journey that reveals the importance of protecting nature and caring for the environment.

Introduction to Jewelry Making Techniques

Tinkering Stations

Interactive spaces where your children can explore, create, experiment and have hands-on learning experiences. Join the challenge and participate in many practical experiments, which allow you to assemble, test and transform your ideas and creativity into a tangible product. Use different materials to create whatever you want, whether it is a car, a house, a rocket or anything else. Join us to start designing and bring your ideas to life!
